name: An Ambassador of Evil
summary: In the Badlands, Historian Karnik sends you after Ambassador Infernus. He wants you to carry proof of the kill to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

sections.title: The Ambassador in Angor Fortress
sections.body: Ragnaros sent Ambassador Infernus to Angor Fortress to oversee the Shadowforge's hunt for lost artifacts in Uldaman. The search has already cost many dwarven lives, and more are dying. Karnik fears the Shadowforge could turn the artifacts against Ironforge. So he sends you back into the Badlands to destroy Infernus and carry Belgrum proof of your victory. Time is short. Ragnaros will not wait for the Shadowforge to prepare.

sections.title: Belgrum's Thanks
sections.body: Advisor Belgrum praises your devotion to Ironforge and its people. He will send word of your success to Karnik, and help will go to the Badlands to retake the excavation site. In King Bronzebeard's name, Belgrum has one more request for you.

faq.answer: Ragnaros sent Infernus to Angor Fortress to oversee the Shadowforge's hunt for lost artifacts in Uldaman.
Ambassador Infernus is in Angor Fortress, in the Badlands.

faq.q: Why does Karnik want Ambassador Infernus destroyed?
aliases: what is infernus doing in uldaman
faq.answer: The Shadowforge's search in Uldaman has already cost many dwarven lives. Karnik fears the artifacts they find could be used against Ironforge.

faq.q: Who gives and ends this quest?
aliases: who starts an ambassador of evil
who turns in ambassador of evil
faq.answer: Historian Karnik in Ironforge sends you after Infernus. You carry proof of victory to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

aliases: what do i need from infernus
faq.answer: Advisor Belgrum wants Ambassador Infernus' Bracer as proof of your victory.
